title: The Paprika Comet Kitchen
description: On comet night, the rooftop cook sifts paprika through a brass sieve. The red dust curls out the window and becomes the comet’s tail.
alt: A cook sifts red paprika beside an open window as a glowing plume rises toward a comet over the rooftops.
pairing: An autumn comet festival × a tail made of sifted paprika
